format: C# ASP.NET Web Forms (.aspx.cs partial code-behind)
description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page 'ShowAns.aspx', responsible for displaying students' answers and marks for different questions in an online examination system, and allowing submission of updated marks.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the 'ShowAns.aspx' page, managing display and submission of student exam answers.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves student answers from database and populates UI controls.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates database with the new score, removes student from course queue, and possibly updates admin queues.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
